a.lede: A community-developed project brings DirectX 12 and Vulkan 1.4 support to Microsoft's retired operating system, allowing modern Nvidia, AMD, and Intel graphics cards to work with Windows 7.
a.title: 17-year-old Windows 7 gets unofficial DirectX 12 and Vulkan 1.4 support

b.lede: MSI's EdgeMesa N AI+ brings Nvidia RTX Spark N1X power to a Windows-on-Arm mini PC with 128GB of unified memory, strong local AI performance, and the ability to game on the side. But its high $7,499 price isn't that much cheaper than more versatile DGX Spark systems.
b.title: MSI EdgeMesa N AI+ review: RTX Spark power comes to Windows on Arm desktops, but there are trade-offs
